reproducibility_status: aggregates can be recomputed; model inference cannot be rerun because the checkpoint is missing
limitations: The common set overlaps historical training-source data.
The common set uses six main and 37 sub labels; run_002 used five main and 34 sub labels.
Taxonomy concepts changed between the historical training and common-set labels.
The common set was later used for model selection, so it is not an independent blind test.
These values are an audit of preserved historical predictions, not current model performance.
